The %1$sstatus page%2$s displays all the entries for the current user. The administrator sees all the entries.
The %1$ssubmit page%2$s displays the forms that have been published for workflows.
No, all users will access via the WordPress Dashboard (Workflow menu).
WordPress will automatically install important Gravity Flow bug fixes, security enhancements and plugin updates. Updates are extremely important to the security of your site.

This feature is activated by default unless you opt to disable it below. We only recommend disabling automatic updates if you intend on managing updates manually. A valid license is required for automatic updates.

By disabling automatic updates your site may not get critical bug fixes and security enhancements. We only recommend doing this if you are experienced at managing a WordPress site and accept the risks involved in manually keeping your WordPress site updated.
